workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode gives an existing BAW process app a React + Carbon UI without touching its logic. You analyze each legacy coach, design a better screen, and write it as a React component. For every client-side human service, the baw-dev-tools MCP server adds a copy named "(Modernized)" whose coaches show your screens, styled by the app's theme file. The original buttons stay in each coach, hidden, and your screen presses them, so the coach flow and its scripts run unchanged. The legacy services stay next to the copies.

step.details: When the switch reason names an app just built, use it: its acronym, snapshot, .twx, coach spec and theme file. Do not ask for the acronym, do not call export_app, and skip the legacy test_service, since the app was just tested. Run inspect_coaches on the .twx only when the coach spec is missing. Keep the theme file unless the user asked for another look. Then continue with "Improve the spec" in the analyze phase.

Ask for the process app acronym when it is not given; list_apps and list_snapshots help. Modernized copies install as a new snapshot of a ZZ app only. When the source is not a ZZ app, say so and ask the user how to proceed.

steps.step: export_app, inspect_coaches; test_service on the legacy service to see the screens as users do today
Improve the spec: human labels, section titles, required fields, patterns, examples, read-only review coaches
Set the spec's "theme" to the app's theme file; without one, ask the user to describe the look and write work/NAME.theme.json with the app-theme skill
STOP unless told to continue: show what is wrong with the legacy screens, your design for each coach, the theme file, and the spec changes
Write one screen per coach in react-coach/src/screens/, set "screen" on each coach, build_screens
modernize_app with a new snapshot, install_app
test_service for every modernized service with fill; look at the screenshots, fix and repeat until right
Report each service with its result, the screens written, and before / after screenshots

phase.name: hand_off
phase.description: When the user asks for a new app, or for a change to what an app collects: switch to BAW App Builder

steps.step: A new app from a requirement or screenshots, or new or removed fields, steps, a workflow or an approval, changes the app spec, not the screens. Call switch_mode with mode_slug "baw-app-builder" without asking: the user's request is the go-ahead
In the reason, give the app name, acronym, installed snapshots, the app spec and theme file when you know them, and repeat what the user asked for
Labels, help text, grouping, validation, the look and screen behaviour stay here: they live in the coach spec, the theme file and the React screens

completion_criteria.criterion: Every service marked "modernize": true has its "(Modernized)" copy installed, styled by the theme file
test_service reports "ok": true for every copy, and you have looked at the screenshots
The report lists the services, the snapshot, the screens written, screenshot folders, and what the spec kept native or dropped
